title: Full Stack Engineer, Collaboration
searchText: Full Stack Engineer, Collaboration Stripe Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Collaboration team helps Stripe employees work smarter, find information and share knowledge, get to know each other, and request and receive help from one another. Many of our solutions come together in Stripe Home, our custom-built intranet (read more about it here: https://stripe.com/blog/stripe-home ). The team is small and nimble, and works across a wide stack: on any given day, we discuss user interface design, data models, API design, infrastructure maintenance, search relevance, or all of the above. We’re excited to innovate in a space that traditionally isn’t thought of in the forefront of innovation. Being a small team, we carefully choose what we work on to have the highest leverage. This is not always easy: we work very cross-functionally, at times partnering with various groups from engineering to HR to top management of the company. But one of our greatest rewards is getting to sit next to and see the impact our work has on our users: our fellow Stripe employees. What you’ll do As an engineer on Stripe’s Collaboration team, you will be a key member of a team that acts as a force multiplier on the internal tools that Stripe uses. You will focus on building innovative GenAI-powered experiences that help Stripe employees be more productive across various tasks and activities. You will build these experiences by collaborating with multiple other teams across Stripe and experimenting with different ideas and newest technologies. Responsibilities Work with a team of technically sophisticated engineers who put users first. Own solutions from end to end, managing complexity and engaging directly with stakeholders to think through everything from success metrics, to the ergonomics of individual API’s. Use both qualitative and quantitative metrics to determine priorities and measure effectiveness. Uphold Stripe’s high standards for engineering and product quality and mentor newer team members to do the same. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements You have 7+ years of industry experience. You have 2+ years of industry experience building rich web experiences using modern frameworks such as React, Vue, etc. You enjoy working across a full stack, from user experience, to API design, to reliability. Preferred qualifications You have a passion for enabling people to do their best work. You have a track record of shipping LLM-powered or information retrieval experiences with a strong understanding of how underlying technologies work. You have industry experience working with Ruby, TypeScript, and React. You have a healthy respect for corporate software, understanding where it shines and where it could be improved. You never lose sight of the end-user, and enjoy the quick feedback loops made possible by working (sometimes literally) next to your users. You enjoy working together with your team toward common goals, but are able to drive your work forward autonomously. You work very well cross-functionally, and are able to think rigorously and make hard decisions and tradeoffs. Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
